content:
You are an expert scheduling formalizer.

Translate each natural-language async planning problem into a JSON scheduling
specification for a CP-SAT solver.

Rules:
1. Each numbered step in the problem becomes exactly one action.
2. Use action="task" for every action.
3. Use the exact ids step1, step2, ..., stepN based on the step numbers in the
   problem text.
4. Use item values identical to the action ids: step1, step2, ..., stepN.
5. Duration must be the integer number of seconds for that step.
6. Add a dependency only when the problem states that one step must happen
   before another. Do not add extra dependencies.
7. Do not add stations, robots, or resources.
8. Output only valid JSON in this exact shape:
{
  "actions": [
    {"id": "step1", "action": "task", "item": "step1", "duration": 120},
    {"id": "step2", "action": "task", "item": "step2", "duration": 300}
  ],
  "dependencies": [
    {"before": "step1", "after": "step2"}
  ]
}
9. Before finishing, verify that:
   - every step from 1..N appears exactly once in actions
   - every dependency endpoint is an existing action id
   - durations are integer seconds
   - there are no duplicate actions

Translate this planning problem into a CP-SAT scheduling JSON spec.

Problem:
To count to ten in norwegian, here are the steps needed.
Step 1. Purchase a Norwegian language textbook (2 hours)
Step 2. Recite the number "en" (1 second)
Step 3. Download a language learning app (5 minutes)
Step 4. Recite the number "ti" (1 second)
Step 5. Research the history of Scandinavian numerals (1 hour)
Step 6. Recite the number "fem" (1 second)
Step 7. Watch a video on Norwegian vowel sounds (15 minutes)
Step 8. Practice the "e" sound in "en" (2 minutes)
Step 9. Practice the "to" sound (2 minutes)
Step 10. Listen to a recording of the number "fire" (10 seconds)
Step 11. Recite the number "tre" (1 second)
Step 12. Recite the number "fire" (1 second)
Step 13. Memorize the spelling of "syv" (5 minutes)
Step 14. Practice the "to" diphthong (3 minutes)
Step 15. Look up the pronunciation of "fire" (1 minute)
Step 16. Practice the "f" sound (2 minutes)
Step 17. Find a list of Norwegian numbers 1-10 (2 minutes)
Step 18. Set up a study schedule (30 minutes)
Step 19. Practice the "t" sound (2 minutes)
Step 20. Recite the sequence 1-3 (3 seconds)
Step 21. Learn the word for "three" (1 minute)
Step 22. Practice the "r" roll in Norwegian (10 minutes)
Step 23. Listen to a native speaker count to ten (30 seconds)
Step 24. Recite the number "åtte" (1 second)
Step 25. Recite the sequence 1-10 (10 seconds)
Step 26. Learn the word for "five" (1 minute)
Step 27. Practice the "n" sound (1 minute)
Step 28. Recite the sequence 1-5 (5 seconds)
Step 29. Practice the "s" sound (2 minutes)
Step 30. Recite the number "seks" (1 second)
Step 31. Learn the word for "six" (1 minute)
Step 32. Recite the number "syv" (1 second)
Step 33. Learn the word for "two" (1 minute)
Step 34. Practice the "ks" consonant cluster (3 minutes)
Step 35. Practice the "e" sound in "en" again (2 minutes)
Step 36. Practice the "v" sound (2 minutes)
Step 37. Buy a notebook for vocabulary (20 minutes)
Step 38. Learn the word for "four" (1 minute)
Step 39. Search for a Norwegian tutor online (45 minutes)
Step 40. Watch a tutorial on the Norwegian "r" (10 minutes)
Step 41. Read a blog post about counting in Norwegian (10 minutes)
Step 42. Recite the number "to" (1 second)
Step 43. Practice the "t" and "i" sounds for ten (2 minutes)
Step 44. Recite the number "ni" (1 second)
Step 45. Find a quiet place to study (5 minutes)
Step 46. Look up the word for "seven" (1 minute)
Step 47. Learn the word for "four" (1 minute)
Step 48. Practice the "v" sound in "syv" (2 minutes)
Step 49. Practice the "r" sound in "tre" (5 minutes)
Step 50. Practice the "s" sound in "syv" (2 minutes)
Step 51. Look up the word for "six" (1 minute)
Step 52. Recite the sequence 1-4 (4 seconds)
Step 53. Practice the "k" sound (1 minute)
Step 54. Practice the "y" vowel (3 minutes)
Step 55. Learn the word for "seven" (1 minute)
Step 56. Recite the sequence 1-10 slowly (20 seconds)
Step 57. Learn the word for "eight" (1 minute)
Step 58. Find a Norwegian-English dictionary (10 minutes)
Step 59. Learn the word for "nine" (1 minute)
Step 60. Recite the sequence 1-6 (6 seconds)
